page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head above the text; catchword at the right below the last line; signature mark at the left of the foot.

main_text.p: am, homine dignam, aut esse inte-grum aliquod syftema, aut syfte-matis partem,aut denique plurium syftematum farraginem. Sic verbi gratiaPhysica eft syftema integrum: Cosmologia eft syftematis phyfici pars : Magia naturalis eft farrago phyfices & mathefeos. Unde li-quet, omnem , quæ cum rectâ ra-tione fufcipitur, tractationem, esse tripartitam. Quod quidem hoc lo-co præterire minimè oportuit: ne varietas titulorū inhoc opere hanc forte alicui ingereret opinionem, innumerabiles esse philofophici circuli difciplinas. Oportet hic accu-rate difcernere inter difciplinam, & partem difciplinæ: & rurfus in-ter difciplinam , & plurium difci-plinarum combinationem. Sic ita-que habeas velim. Quidquid in hoc opere occurrit,aut eft difciplina in-tegrè

page.notes: Long s throughout is plain s (e.g. "esse" printed with long-s double letters as "effe"). The signature mark at the foot reads "(:) s" and is uncertain. The catchword "tegrè" is printed as the start of the next page's word "integrè"; kept as printed. The word "circuli" is broken between lines without a printed hyphen and is written whole. "inhoc" is printed as one word and is kept as printed. The word "titulorū" keeps its macron as printed.
